tools.name: find_river_gauges
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find USGS river or stream gauges (site numbers) by US state and river name, or near a US city or town. Returns up to 25 active gauges with current data, with distance for city searches. Does not accept coordinates and does not return readings; use get_river_conditions

tools.name: get_river_conditions
tools.description: Use this when the user wants current river flow (discharge) or gage height at USGS stream gauges, the 24-hour trend, how today compares with the same date in past years, or a printable condition sheet.
